name: Grant's Shield
summary: Sirra Von’Indie seeks Grant Valor’s mace in Raven Hill Cemetery, where his spirit still battles the undead. The weapons may help her learn more about the proud hero.

sections.title: A Fallen Hero
sections.body: Sirra Von’Indie in Darkshire asks you to find Grant Valor’s mace among the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery. Grant’s shield was left behind by his specter, and his spirit still fights the undead there. The mace may point to the creature that injured him, and Sirra wants to study the weapons.

sections.title: The Weapons
sections.body: In Darkshire, Sirra Von’Indie reflects on how a simple creature brought Grant Valor low. She says a single slip can cripple a person for life. The weapons, she believes, tell much about their owner, and she takes time to study them.

faq.answer: Grant Valor was the father of the Valor family and a hero of Raven Hill. His specter still battles the undead.
Grant’s mace is on one of the skeletons in Raven Hill Cemetery.

faq.q: Why am I looking for Grant's mace?
faq.answer: Sirra Von’Indie asks you to find the mace so she can learn more from Grant’s weapons.

faq.q: Where do I take the mace?
faq.answer: Return Grant’s mace to Sirra Von’Indie in Darkshire.
Grant was injured by a creature in Raven Hill Cemetery. His spirit still battles the undead there.
